nom: Pacifica Melt For You Moisturizing Oil Cleanser

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report good results, including help calming hormonal breakouts and no greasy residue, though one combination/oily-leaning reviewer found it drying in low-humidity winter conditions.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe it as hydrating and non-stripping, with makeup fully removed and skin left soft rather than tight, though one dry-skin user found it strangely drying compared to a true oil cleanser.
segments.combination: The one combination-skin reviewer found it extremely drying and felt it stripped her moisture barrier.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, no breakouts, and calmer redness over time, while others describe severe reactions including burning, swelling, redness, or allergic responses, especially with eye contact.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically discuss mature skin.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the cleanser hydrates and does not strip or dry the skin, but a smaller group (combination and one dry-skin user) report it stripped moisture and felt drying, particularly in winter or low humidity.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, breakout-prone skin reports reduced facial redness after two months of use, while several others describe the product itself causing red, swollen, or burning skin on contact, especially near the eyes.
concerns.barrier: One combination-skin reviewer explicitly says the product stripped her moisture barrier and caused irritation; most other reviewers report no barrier disruption.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with breakout-prone or acne-prone skin mostly report no new breakouts and even improvement, but one reviewer says the product broke her out and made her skin hot to the touch.
concerns.blemishes: Several sensitive or acne-prone reviewers say breakouts became minimal to non-existent with regular use; no reviewer describes worsened cystic blemishes, though a few mention general breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it removes makeup without feeling greasy and helps with hormonal breakouts; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Effective makeup and waterproof mascara removal
Foams more than expected for an oil cleanser

extraits.texte: I love oil cleansers and I also love Pacifica products. The bottle is beautiful and the fragrance is amazing. I have sensitive skin snd use retin A from time to time. This product burned my face and it took over three days for it to heal. May be ok if you don't use any acids or peels and if you don't have sensitive skin.
I have combination skin, and this was extremely drying for me, even when starting with smoothing an oil over my skin. Stripped my moisture barrier and irritated my skin. Smells really good though.

I have dry skin so I really love using an oil cleanser. Thankfully this cleanser completely removes makeup and cleanses in one step leaving my face fresh and hydrated. It rinses completely and doesn't irritate my skin. I use Retin-A so I need something gentle and effective that will leave my face clean but not stripped. I love the smell and texture of this product. I have tried SO many cleansers in the past and this one really works perfectly for me. Love, Love, Love!!

extraits.titre: Great oil cleanser for double cleansing!
extraits.texte: I have super reactive, acne prone skin. This cleanser is a great addition to my skincare routine to take off makeup and gunk from the day! No issues with breakouts or anything.

I am incredibly picky with face wash as I have sensitive skin with light rosacea, but since using this as my makeup remover/daily cleansing wash my breakouts have been non existent to minimal. I also really appreciate that the peach smell isn't artificially overdone like a lot of peach products tend to be. Please don't discontinue this product, it's a hit for me!!

extraits.titre: Best cleanser I have found in a while
extraits.texte: I have pretty sensitive skin and will break out easily, especially along my chest area and I started using this cleanser two months ago and have seen a huge change in my breakouts as well as my redness in my face. I would definitely recommend and buy again.

Omg, this oil cleanser is ahhhhmazing. Love that it cleases and leaves face feeling super smooth and clean and the peach scent is perfect. Not too strong. Removes makeup very well. Highly recommend. Also I have oily skin and it does wonders.
